title: Benefits of Going Organic
summary: Paywalled teaser from an alternative-health newsletter claiming organic food cuts exposure to pesticides linked to cancer and child brain harm and avoids GMOs and preventive antibiotics.

assertions.quote: Choosing organic foods lowers your exposure to pesticides linked to cancer
pesticides linked to cancer, damage to children’s IQ and neurobehavioral development
Organic foods are produced without genetically modified organisms (GMOs)
the use of antibiotics for preventive purposes is prohibited
both major benefits to human health
